dailyHeadline: CAAAAM'S 10-0 TERROR REIGNS OVER KINGSTON AS THE SNOOZE-FEST STANDINGS AND TRADE ADDICTS COLLIDE IN WEEK 11
dailySubhead: While Caaaam stays undefeated and drops Terry McLaurin for reasons only a madman understands, the rest of the Rhody league scrambles through waivers and questionable trades to salvage their sinking seasons.
tickerTape: BREAKING: Caaaam remains undefeated at 10-0 after crushing Unanswered 158.32 to 123.66 in Week 10!
TRADE ALERT: CarlaCote snags Nico Collins and Blake Corum from PrayingGrantis in a late-week blockbuster!
HEARTBREAK CITY: Shipoopiehole edges out Tylero0 152.56 to 152.14 in an absolute Week 10 thriller!
WAIVER WIRE MADNESS: Tylero0 drops 4 FAAB each on Mark Andrews, Steelers DEF, and Kaelon Black!
DISASTER CLASS: CerealStroke somehow forgets how waivers work all year yet drops 164.18 points on owenriddell!
WITNESS PROTECTION WINS: CarlaCote quietly climbs to 6-4 while dodging league federal agents and ELord11's trade spam!

roasts.headline: Caaaam Sits Atop Mount Keaney At 10-0 While Dropping Terry McLaurin Like A Bad Habit
roasts.body:
Absolute scenes down at the URI Quad this morning as Caaaam stands completely alone on the mountaintop at 10-0 with 1,510 total points. You’d think an undefeated titan would be resting starters and sipping iced coffee at the Daily Grind, but no—Caaaam is out here playing 4D chess by dropping Terry McLaurin and Jason Sanders straight to waivers because regular roster management is simply beneath a god. Meanwhile, the rest of the league is staring up at this juggernaut wondering if anyone can even buy a win against the Kingston Empire.

Down at the absolute bottom of the cellar, CerealStroke and owenriddell are battling it out for the right to buy the first round at The Ocean Mist. Owen has rattled off seven straight losses like a broken record player, proving that drafting a fantasy roster is actually harder than passing an 8:00 AM Econ lecture. If Caaaam keeps this pace up, we’re going to have to engrave the Rhody trophy before Thanksgiving.

roasts.headline: PrayingGrantis and CarlaCote Make Late-Week Swap As Trade Addiction Spreads Through Kingston
roasts.body:
ELord11 might be the card-carrying president of the compulsive trade addicts anonymous club, but PrayingGrantis and CarlaCote decided to get in on the action right before Week 10 kicked off. Grantis shipped off Nico Collins and Blake Corum to Carla in exchange for Matthew Golden, proving once again that Superteam builders love nothing more than shaking up a roster that's already sitting pretty at 7-3.

CarlaCote, operating strictly out of an undisclosed witness protection safehouse somewhere in South County, continues to sneak into victories while hoarding assets like a squirrel preparing for a nuclear winter. Grabbing Collins gives Carla's 6-4 squad a legitimate championship weapon, while Grantis takes Matthew Golden and probably texts the league group chat asking if anyone wants to re-trade him by noon. Classic Rhody behavior.

roasts.headline: Tylero0 Blows FAAB On Mark Andrews And Steelers D While Shipoopiehole Snags Seth McGowan
roasts.body:
The Tuesday night waiver wire in Rhody was an absolute zoo, and Tylero0 was the zookeeper handing out four-dollar bills like candy on Halloween. Tylero0 dropped Keon Coleman and Tyler Higbee to scoop up Mark Andrews, the Pittsburgh Steelers defense, and Kaelon Black, burning precious FAAB like it's burning fuel at Toot's Bar & Grille. When you're sitting at 7-3 and coming off a heart-wrenching 0.42-point loss to Shipoopiehole, you'll do pretty much anything to fix your tight end spot.

Speaking of Shipoopiehole, they decided 5 FAAB was a fair price to pay for Seth McGowan on Wednesday morning, rounding out a week where everyone tried desperately to plug holes in sinking ships. JewsinParis also jumped into the fray, coughing up 8 FAAB for the Buffalo Bills defense because apparently streaming isn't stressful enough when you're sitting comfortably in the playoff mix at 7-3.

roasts.headline: Week 11 Slate Kicks Off With Caaaam vs CarlaCote And Tylero0 Looking To Bounce Back Against owenriddell
roasts.body:
As we stare down Week 11 across Kingston, the matchup slate is dripping with absolute drama. Undefeated Caaaam puts the 10-0 record on the line against witness-protection fugitive CarlaCote, who is riding a tidy two-game win streak. If Carla manages to hand Caaaam loss number one, the celebration at The Coast Guard House will be heard all the way up in Lippitt Hall.

Elsewhere, Tylero0 looks to wash the taste of that brutal 152.56 to 152.14 loss to Shipoopiehole out of their mouth by taking on owenriddell, who is currently drowning in a seven-game losing streak. If owen can't pull off an upset against Tyler's newly revamped roster, we might need to send a search party down to Toot's to check on morale. Meanwhile, ELord11 faces CerealStroke in a battle of teams desperately searching for an identity and a pulse.

powerRankings.blurb: Ten and oh, baby! Dropping Terry McLaurin for funsies just to flex on the entire league while sitting comfortably atop the standings.
Built a superteam, traded away Nico Collins for Matthew Golden, and picked up Kirk Cousins just because. Life is good at 7-3.
Suffered a devastating 0.42-point heartbreak last week and responded by blowing FAAB on Mark Andrews and the Steelers defense.
Still recovering from the legendary historical trauma of trading Drake London for Jordan Mason, but holding strong at 7-3 nonetheless.
Operating out of witness protection while quietly stacking wins, snagging Nico Collins, and climbing to a smooth 6-4 record.
Hit a brick wall against Caaaam last week and now sits right at .500 trying to piece together a playoff push.
Riding a five-game losing skid while trading every player on the roster twice a week like a Wall Street day trader with no safety net.
Stole a victory by 0.42 points last week and immediately spent 5 FAAB on Seth McGowan to keep the momentum rolling.
Seven losses in a row. At this point, the only thing colder than owen's lineup is a January windchill blowing off Narragansett Bay.
Ignores waivers completely, leaves 214 points on the bench all season, and somehow still managed to smash owen last week.

tradeGrades.summary: CarlaCote received Nico Collins & Blake Corum; PrayingGrantis received Matthew Golden
tradeGrades.verdict: Carla sneaks out of the shadows and fleeces Grantis for a true WR1 in Nico Collins while Grantis gambles on Matthew Golden.

tradeGrades.summary: ELord11 received Drake London & Garrett Wilson; Tylero0 received Puka Nacua
tradeGrades.verdict: Two trade addicts swapping high-end wideouts in a deal so chaotic it probably required a league-wide wellness check.

tradeGrades.summary: Unanswered received Josh Jacobs & Jaylen Waddle; ELord11 received A.J. Brown
tradeGrades.verdict: ELord11 couldn't resist making another trade and handed over two studs for A.J. Brown in classic compulsive fashion.

tradeGrades.summary: ELord11 received Trey McBride & Emeka Egbuka; owenriddell received Kyren Williams, Omarion Hampton & Tyler Warren
tradeGrades.verdict: A five-player blockbuster where ELord11 satisfied their trade craving while owen stacked up useful depth pieces.
